summary: Send an asynchronous main-to-renderer message from a WebContents.

target.notes: Use renderer routing plus Structured Clone serialization.

caveats: Functions, Promises, Symbols, WeakMaps and WeakSets must throw on serialization.
Sending via event.sender.send always targets the main frame of that WebContents; event.reply has different frame routing semantics.

tests.name: send cloneable payload
tests.expected_behavior: renderer receives a cloned payload asynchronously
